title: Normalization-compatible evaluation of actual local Isom sheaves
statement: Let B_n be finite commutative rings with maps q_n:B_(n+1)→B_n, and E_n,K_n derived module and etale module-sheaf objects. Supply universal normalization arrows dE_n,dK_n into derived scalar restriction. They induce morphisms r_n of the actual derived local Isom sheaves. Use the constructed canonical sourceDerivedIsoEvaluation [def-weil-pbc-source-derived-isomorphism-evaluation] on affine weakly contractible pro-etale objects; evaluation of r_n obeys exactly the adjunct normalization square with the specified dE_n,dK_n. This constructs neither a cover nor local isomorphisms from nonempty stalks. Definitions: [def-weil-pbc-derived-normalization-arrows], [def-weil-pbc-derived-local-isomorphism-sheaf], [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site].

proof.text: Constant realization carries each specified universal module normalization arrow to the universal sheaf normalization arrow, using the independent constant-realization result.

At each consecutive coefficient map apply the source-site universal-arrow Isom reduction theorem to the constant object and K. Choose the resulting family of reduction maps and retain its canonical evaluation squares.

theorem normalized_derived_isomorphism_section_reduction
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (B : ℕ → Type (u + 1)) [∀ n : ℕ, CommRing (B n)]
    [∀ n : ℕ, Finite (B n)] (q : ∀ n : ℕ, B (n + 1) →+* B n)
    (E : ∀ n : ℕ, DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (B n)))
    (K : ∀ n : ℕ, DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (B n))))
    (dE : ∀ n : ℕ, E (n + 1) ⟶ (normalizationModuleRestrict (q n)).obj (E n))
    (dK : ∀ n : ℕ, K (n + 1) ⟶
      (normalizationRestrict X.smallEtaleTopology (q n)).obj (K n))
    (hη : ∀ n : ℕ, Nonempty (StructuredArrow.IsUniversal (StructuredArrow.mk (dE n))))
    (hρ : ∀ n : ℕ, Nonempty (StructuredArrow.IsUniversal (StructuredArrow.mk (dK n)))) :
    ∃ r : ∀ n : ℕ,
      derivedLocalIsomorphismSheaf ((normalizationConstant X.smallEtaleTopology).obj
        (E (n + 1))) (K (n + 1)) ⟶
      derivedLocalIsomorphismSheaf ((normalizationConstant X.smallEtaleTopology).obj
        (E n)) (K n),
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : X.ProEt) (ha : IsAffine U.left)
        (hw : (ProEt.topology X).IsWeaklyContractible.{u + 1} U)
        (s : ((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback (toProEt X)
          (Type (u + 1)) X.smallEtaleTopology (ProEt.topology X)).obj
          (derivedLocalIsomorphismSheaf ((normalizationConstant X.smallEtaleTopology).obj
            (E (n + 1))) (K (n + 1)))).obj.obj (op U)),
        (sourceDerivedIsoEvaluation X (B (n + 1))
          ((normalizationConstant X.smallEtaleTopology).obj (E (n + 1)))
          (K (n + 1)) U ha hw s).hom ≫ localProEtaleNormalization U.hom (q n) (dK n) =
          localProEtaleNormalization U.hom (q n)
              (normalizationConstantArrow X.smallEtaleTopology (q n) (dE n)) ≫
            (normalizationRestrict (ProEt.topology U.left) (q n)).map
              (sourceDerivedIsoEvaluation X (B n)
                ((normalizationConstant X.smallEtaleTopology).obj (E n)) (K n) U ha hw
                (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback (toProEt X)
                  (Type (u + 1)) X.smallEtaleTopology (ProEt.topology X)).map
                    (r n)).hom.app (op U) s)).hom
